title: Europe to join U.S.-brokered Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi despite Kremlin objections
detail: European officials will attend U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday and Wednesday, defying Kremlin objections. Peskov accused European governments of not deciding who speaks for them while acknowledging security talks would eventually need Europe.
